domains.name: Night lifecycle, recovery and delayed Day notices
Act IV investigation and canonical continuity
Orbital staging and shared HUD ownership

contracts.failure_mode: Forty sequential script fetches accumulate network latency, or a loading optimization executes dependent modules early and changes runtime ownership.
contracts.invariant: At most four future production scripts are hinted, with the consuming hint retired after load. Hints never execute code; script execution, actor enforcement, wrapper freezing, timer parking, errors and readiness remain under the existing serial bootstrap. Unsupported or failed hints fall back without blocking startup.
contracts.spot_check: Compare the bootstrap request chain with hints supported and ignored; verify every file executes once in FILES order, no temporary hint remains, timers stay parked, and real Day/Night/Good Dogs acceptance still passes. Treat simulated network timing separately from physical-device or live cold-start performance.

contracts.failure_mode: An environment without an H.264 decoder attempts the authored movie and enters a retry or autoplay loop.
contracts.invariant: Playback eligibility is decided from MediaSource.isTypeSupported and HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType, never a user-agent string; unsupported environments explain that video is unavailable and retain an explicit Skip control.
contracts.spot_check: Stub both capability probes as unsupported; confirm no media source is loaded, VIDEO UNAVAILABLE and the recovery explanation are visible, Skip is reachable, and campaign state is unchanged.

contracts.failure_mode: Media failure or missing decode advances the campaign without a completed movie or deliberate skip.
contracts.invariant: Only COMPLETED or USER_SKIPPED may settle a cutscene; capability failure is non-terminal and cannot write watched state.
contracts.spot_check: Open a cutscene with both probes unsupported and verify its promise remains pending until the explicit SKIP control is used.

contracts.failure_mode: A double tap, keyboard event, or late ended event applies cutscene completion more than once.
contracts.invariant: The first terminal event owns settlement; every later skip or completion event is a no-op and produces no second state write.
contracts.spot_check: Trigger skip twice and then emit ended; verify one result, one state write, and the same narrative state as a single skip.

contracts.failure_mode: A historical Felicia confrontation, boss, unlock, or day-ending route re-enters canonical Story Bible mode.
contracts.invariant: Canonical story mode fails closed across every historical route and Felicia becomes playable only after the ordered Act VI Duet reward.
contracts.spot_check: Load canonical mode with legacy Felicia save keys and call public legacy scene APIs; no retired scene, reward, or durable unlock may fire.

contracts.failure_mode: Day, Night, and Good Dogs retain duplicate presentation or input ownership after a handoff.
contracts.invariant: The production bootstrap installs one runtime mode shell and repeated enter/exit calls restore the exact owned surface and input snapshot once.
contracts.spot_check: Enter and exit Night twice from both title and Day; confirm one shell install, no held input, no duplicate blockers, and exact Day restoration.

contracts.failure_mode: Unchanged frame updates replace the campaign button's text child during a held pointer press, and native WebKit fails to deliver the terminal click despite a stable world and unobstructed target.
contracts.invariant: Unchanged frames retain the campaign control, label node, click owner, attributes and inline geometry without redundant writes. Actual label changes, resize and specialized-HUD handoffs update only changed presentation. The lifecycle regression must fail if unconditional writes return; one native held gesture must still open the campaign menu without retry, forced click or narrative mutation.
contracts.spot_check: Run scripts/night_lifecycle_browser.mjs in actual desktop WebKit on the exact candidate: hold the native campaign press for 100 ms across render frames, verify stable label identity through pointerdown/pointerup/click and an immediately visible Sector 04 menu, then resume the same world with evidence unchanged. Keep the real mobile tap check; unit DOM mutation checks alone do not establish native click delivery.

contracts.failure_mode: An interrupted run loses its world, duplicates rewards, or silently starts fresh when restoration fails.
contracts.invariant: Validated standalone checkpoints restore the most recent world without changing campaign saves; failed restore stops at the title until an explicit action. Completion tombstones precede settlement.
contracts.spot_check: Move, damage an enemy, travel, reload and Resume Night; compare saved route, health, rewards, enemies and clock. Inject storage failure and confirm visible retry without a fresh run.

contracts.failure_mode: A delayed procedural pager replaces an authored conversation or appears in a different run.
contracts.invariant: Day notices wait for the current modal to release and expire across changed run, day or standalone mode.
contracts.spot_check: Keep an investigation open beyond the pager delay. Close it and receive the notice once; starting a different mode must cancel the stale notice.

contracts.failure_mode: Selecting an approach immediately awards alliance, or technical recovery is mistaken for requester success.
contracts.invariant: Observations, supported hypothesis, bounded response, technical verification, requester confirmation and shared report occur in order. Evidence and Trust are awarded once at distinct boundaries.
contracts.spot_check: Try a wrong hypothesis, reload mid-investigation, then verify the service. Alliance must remain locked until Inspection confirms its task and the joint report is saved.

contracts.failure_mode: Background playback, stale input or a failed save settles an ending invisibly or twice.
contracts.invariant: The Good Dogs movie, home prologue and Earthfall owners prevent hidden progression and keep focus in the active modal. Earthfall retains visible save retry without repeating semantic completion; the crash movie has its separate executable contract below.
contracts.spot_check: Background the film, deliver ended, return and Resume. Double Skip and retry a failed Earthfall save; verify one terminal narrative transition.

contracts.failure_mode: A crash-movie error, stall watchdog or background fallback advances M2 without visible completion or deliberate Skip.
contracts.invariant: The playback watchdog allows the full remaining duration plus three seconds; healthy playback settles on ended. Capability failure and watchdogs expose recovery without settling; hidden completion waits for visible Resume or Skip, and terminal input is idempotent.
contracts.spot_check: Run the healthy 9.433-second movie to its end, then inject unsupported capability, stalled playback and hidden ended separately. Confirm visible recovery, trapped/restored focus and one completion only after deliberate Skip or visible Resume.

contracts.failure_mode: Artwork or touch movement controls cover choices; stale typewriter handlers restore previous dialogue.
contracts.invariant: Authored art shares the dialogue stacking context, reserves a separate region, and every visible choice is a reachable 44px target; each conversation owns its text.
contracts.spot_check: Open standup and workstation at320px portrait and844px landscape. Use each real choice, scroll if needed, and verify the correct scene copy persists.

contracts.failure_mode: Night controls appear in the wrong layout or shift beneath the player when visual decoration arrives or a shared hover/press animation transforms gameplay buttons.
contracts.invariant: Viewport and active input ownership determine control geometry from startup. Delayed decoration, MORE and hover/press/held feedback cannot relocate persistent targets, obscure actors, overlap controls or reduce the 44px targets.
contracts.spot_check: At 568 by 320, delay only the Night decoration class, launch through real controls, expand MORE, then release decoration while expanded. Force hover/active/held styles and repeat six real toggles; compare target size, hit ownership, actor clearance and persistent control bounds.

contracts.failure_mode: A viewport timer alternately hides and reveals the authoritative Good Dogs HUD.
contracts.invariant: Only the cinematic guard controls the shared hide flag; viewport styling cannot suppress ordinary gameplay. Duplicate objective strips are filtered without removing combat or narrative messages.
contracts.spot_check: Observe portrait gameplay across repeated mobile/cinematic timer ticks, open and close a modal, and verify one stable HUD.

contracts.failure_mode: Good Dogs announces playable Mission 1 while its touch shell remains hidden until a later watchdog tick.
contracts.invariant: A verified synchronous gameplay handoff restores the control shell and canonical pad before publishing gameplay readiness, while authored cinematics remain blocking.
contracts.spot_check: Finish the three home scenes and inspect controls at the first gameplay observation without waiting for a watchdog. Move with the real D-pad in portrait and landscape; verify reachable targets, actor clearance and no overlap.

contracts.failure_mode: A title pointer-up opens a dialog beneath the remaining click, silently choosing Solo or another newly inserted action.
contracts.invariant: Alternate title routes consume the early pointer-up without changing screens and activate once on the terminal click. A separate deliberate action is required to choose a mode; keyboard activation and canonical Day input retain their owners.
contracts.spot_check: At 568 by 320, tap Good Dogs once and confirm the selector remains open without a persisted choice or prologue. Tap Solo separately, then complete the three home scenes. Also cancel/reopen immediately and activate title cards from the keyboard.

contracts.failure_mode: An enabled Good Dogs card swallows a rapid reopen after cancelling its selector.
contracts.invariant: Cancellation releases launch debounce and title ownership synchronously while duplicate events during a live launch still coalesce.
contracts.spot_check: Open the selector, cancel, immediately reopen, and choose Solo or Local. No artificial delay or second tap is needed.

contracts.failure_mode: Green fixtures are presented as physical-device, complete-route or licensed-decoder certification.
contracts.invariant: Release assessment requires matching candidate identity, intact artifact hashes and requirement-specific evidence. Missing physical, decoded-media, unassisted, soak or protection evidence blocks release.
contracts.spot_check: Run npm run release:assess with missing, stale, altered or incomplete reports. Each case must remain blocked; one clip cannot satisfy the full media manifest.

contracts.failure_mode: Reading the difficulty chooser or watching the Night cinematic exhausts the engine timeout and overlays recovery on the unfinished player choice.
contracts.invariant: Only visible engine-convergence polling spends the launch timeout; a visible canonical difficulty chooser, active authored cinematic, or hidden document pauses the budget without selecting, skipping, or reissuing entry. A missing chooser or stalled visible engine still fails within the original budget.
contracts.spot_check: Start fresh Night, leave difficulty unanswered for at least 16 seconds, then choose Standard and finish the intro. Verify one launch and working movement/Resume. Repeat with long cinema and backgrounding; hide a missing chooser or stall the engine to verify bounded failure.

contracts.failure_mode: World scaling shrinks health, objectives, combat instructions and captions below legible screen size.
contracts.invariant: Street Night and Good Dogs essential HUD text stays at least 13 CSS pixels with full wrapped objectives, distinct cards, reserved Night run-menu space and balanced transforms. The original render owners retain world, combat, input and narrative authority.
contracts.spot_check: At 568×320 and 320×568, inspect actual Night and Good Dogs HUDs, then resize. Verify health, threat, location, objective and caption copy without moving world coordinates.

contracts.failure_mode: A readable replacement hides unique combat or narrative feedback, duplicates the legacy strip, or mislabels co-op ownership.
contracts.invariant: The CSS-space HUD wraps objectives and unique messages, labels solo YOU/AI or local P1/P2 according to the active actor, and suppresses legacy feedback only while it owns the replacement.
contracts.spot_check: Switch the active dog, enter local co-op, trigger unique feedback and down a partner; compare labels and health. Remove replacement ownership and verify the legacy unique message returns.

contracts.failure_mode: Baked artwork claims all tickets are assigned to unrelated people before the actual standup choices.
contracts.invariant: The read-only board derives all three tickets, owners and confirmation status from canonical records, never mutates assignments, and cannot present stale baked ownership artwork.
contracts.spot_check: Read the first board, assign one ticket to Amit, then confirm the meeting and reopen it. Compare board and dialogue; scroll the small-screen board to see all three real tickets.

contracts.failure_mode: Tab skips a cutscene, hidden time advances its story, or canvas-only choices exclude keyboard input.
contracts.invariant: Shared v725 scenes use explicit skip/pause keys and semantic captions/choice controls; hidden time freezes until visible Resume, unresolved choices cannot be skipped, focus returns on exit, and repeated settlement commits once.
contracts.spot_check: Tab through Pause/Resume/Skip and actual choice labels. Background a scene, return, Resume, and double Skip; verify correct saved state once and restored focus.

deletion_ledger.removed: The crash fallback plate's 2.2-second automatic completion timer.
deletion_ledger.reason: A loaded image or elapsed hidden-tab time cannot stand in for visible movie completion or deliberate Skip. The approved plate remains as passive recovery artwork.

deletion_ledger.removed: Early Felicia confrontation, secret-boss unlock, premature playable selection, and historical ending schedules in canonical mode.
deletion_ledger.reason: They conflict with the Story Bible v1.2 trust-to-alliance arc and ordered Act VI Duet reward.

deletion_ledger.removed: Automatic b736m8 canvas finale replay from completed standalone Good Dogs resumes.
deletion_ledger.reason: The authored Earthfall authority owns completion, persistence, replay, and return-to-title semantics.

deletion_ledger.removed: Independent mode handoff writes that left Day UI, held input, or ARIA blockers active beneath Night or Good Dogs.
deletion_ledger.reason: One reversible mode shell must own presentation and input boundaries.

deletion_ledger.removed: Canonical Act IV invocation of the legacy racks movie and inherited legacy-choice bridge; historical noncanonical code and assets remain.
deletion_ledger.reason: The legacy movie assigned an enemy and toolkit before observations. The authored native console now owns plan, evidence and human verification.

deletion_ledger.removed: Mobile visual timer writes to the shared Good Dogs hide-HUD flag.
deletion_ledger.reason: They raced the cinematic guard and caused intermittent missing HUDs. Responsive style remains passive.

deletion_ledger.removed: Standup image tiles containing fabricated ticket IDs, unrelated owners and premature 12/12 owned assertions; source images remain available for historical inspection.
deletion_ledger.reason: Presentation now reads the same canonical ticket records as the conversation.

deletion_ledger.removed: Shared cinematic any-key skip and pointerdown-only semantic control activation.
deletion_ledger.reason: Navigation keys must preserve focus and story state; native buttons support keyboard and assistive activation.
